en: The image depicts a large, historic brick building with mansard roofs and classical Dutch architectural features, surrounded by a black iron fence and substantial brick pillars. The scene is shaded by tall trees lining the street in the foreground. There are two figures standing on the street outside the fence. At the bottom of the card, some printed text is visible, most notably the word 'NIJMEGEN.'
